name: Claude AI Mastery
description: Build practical assistants, research workflows, and reliable AI products with Claude.
requirements: A clear user problem and expected AI response
A tested prompt or workflow with example inputs
Useful error handling and responsible AI guidance
A public GitHub repository with setup instructions
A short LinkedIn post explaining what you learned

challenges.title: Build a Research Question Generator

A clear explanation generated from the selected topic
At least five practice questions with feedback
Responsible handling of uncertain answers

challenges.title: Draft Product Requirements

name: Data Science

Documented data cleaning and assumptions
At least three meaningful findings or model results
Clear visualisations with readable labels
A public repository with data and run instructions
